en: Well, Jerry congratulations after you came
over to the bench. You just dropped
your head and kind of stared at the court
for a little while. What's going
through your mind after two hours
and 45 minutes of that?
Well, I think first of all,
Andrey is a great friend.
He's a great competitor, a good champion
on the courts, and it's a pleasure
to share the court with him again
since since last time we played
in Hong Kong,
but more happily, I'm healthy.
I'm 100% playing my best tennis
and just really happy
to be in Montreal playing healthy
and playing happy again
What does a win like
that do for you do for your confidence?
And what does it tell you
about what your level is right now?
Well, I think I know the tennis is there
but I just have to have to get it out of me
and stay healthy. But again,
that's the that's the biggest part
about being a top player. Andrey, Andrey, he
has that and he's competing all year.
So that's something
that I have to learn from the top players
to get my level back. Just again super happy
to be healthy.
That's the number one priority
and if I can win some matches,
that'll be amazing too
Jerry.
Thanks so much.
Thank you
